name: gamescom asia
blurb: Southeast Asia's largest gaming business-and-consumer expo, now combined with Thailand Game Show and held at QSNCC Bangkok each autumn.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 returns to the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, Bangkok, from 29 October to 1 November 2026.' Countdown timer on the same (same-day) render agreed ('will start in 24 Days').

notes: Branded jointly as 'gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show' since the 2025 merger, matching the given note about the move from Singapore to Bangkok's QSNCC. No celebrity/creator guest roster exists: the site's only named-people feature, 'Asia Game Talent Showcase', is a student game-development competition run by the Thai Game Association, not a guest list, and there is no speakers/guests page in the nav (About/Exhibit/entertainment area/business area/Media/Travel) — treated as a trade+consumer show with guests:none per the rules.
